entity_name: Litani River Authority (المصلحة الوطنية لنهر الليطاني)

facts.value: Boundary/context authority for Litani River basin assets, irrigation networks, water projects, and related project infrastructure.
facts.human_review_reason: Use LRA only when complaint evidence identifies a Litani/LRA asset, project, basin, or irrigation-network boundary.

facts.value: Geographic scope is project/basin-specific rather than a municipality-default drinking-water resolver. Ordinary municipal water complaints should still resolve to BMLWE, NLWE, SLWE, or BWE by municipality.
facts.human_review_reason: Asset ownership and project boundary must be verified before dispatch.

facts.value: Do not use LRA as a default water establishment. It is a boundary authority for Litani/project/irrigation cases.

hitl_conditions: complaint only mentions normal municipal water service
